newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MedQuist estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MedQuist estimates raised.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens said analyst Sheryl Skolnick reiterated her buy rating and raised her earnings per share estimate on MedQuist Inc.
-- She raised her 1997 forecast to $0.94 from $0.87.

-- "In our view, the electronic medical transcription services provided by MedQuist are the most cost effective and efficient method of storing and distributing free-form dictation into the electronic patient record," the analyst said in a report.
